description: This is the main source file for a Flutter-based note-taking application. It includes app theme definitions, the main application widget with theme toggling, a Note data model, a provider for state management (handling CRUD operations and search), SQLite database interaction, and various UI components such as home screen, note list tiles, detail view, editing modal, and delete confirmation dialog.

classes.name: AppPalette
classes.description: Defines a set of color constants used for consistent theming across the app.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Model class representing a note, with serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: Provides state management for the list of notes, including CRUD operations, search filtering, and syncing with the database.

classes.name: NoteDatabase
classes.description: Encapsulates SQLite database operations for notes, including opening the database and CRUD functions.

classes.name: NotesApp
classes.description: The main widget managing theme mode toggling and home screen.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main screen showing the list of notes, search bar, FAB for creating new notes, and theme toggle button.

classes.name: _SearchBarWidget
classes.description: Widget for the search input, updating the search query in provider.

classes.name: _EmptyState
classes.description: UI shown when there are no notes.

classes.name: _NoteListTile
classes.description: Displays individual note summary in a card, navigates to detail view on tap.

classes.name: NoteDetailScreen
classes.description: Screens showing full note details with options to edit or delete.

classes.name: NoteEditModal
classes.description: Modal dialog for creating or editing a note.

classes.name: _ConfirmDeleteDialog
classes.description: Alert dialog to confirm note deletion.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the app, initializes Flutter bindings, opens database, and runs the app.

methods.name: Note.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of a Note instance with optional updated fields.

methods.name: Note.toMap
methods.description: Serializes a Note object into a Map for database storage.

methods.name: Note.fromMap
methods.description: Deserializes a Map from database into a Note object.

methods.name: NotesProvider._refreshNotes
methods.description: Refreshes the local notes list from the database.

methods.name: NotesProvider.addNote
methods.description: Adds a new note to the database.

methods.name: NotesProvider.updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database.

methods.name: NotesProvider.deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from the database.

methods.name: NoteDatabase.open
methods.description: Opens or creates the local SQLite database.

methods.name: NoteDatabase.listNotes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of notes from the database.

methods.name: NoteDatabase.insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note record into the database.

methods.name: _toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark themes.

methods.name: _formatDateShort
methods.description: Formats a DateTime as a short string (time or date).

methods.name: _formatFullDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime into a full, human-readable date and time string.

methods.name: NotesProvider.getById
methods.description: Fetches a note by its ID from the local list.
